column1: # The outcome of a store answer for the client (the store client contract common/contracts/store-client.md «Outcomes and what the client does» outcome, no_reply; SC-WIRE78-G01).
# A row: case<TAB>input<TAB>expect<TAB>note. The form — the package README.

column4: note
a readable row
an absent row: items null, index ""
a damaged row exists and has a version — not absent
a read answer not by the closed form — an unreadable answer: unavailable
the answer did not come — for a read unavailable, not «no»
a truncated listing answer — unavailable
a listing
a version in the listing not by the wire form (a leading zero) — an unreadable listing answer: unavailable
the write is done
the answer of a saved repeat of the same id — also written
a version not by the wire form (a leading zero) — an unreadable write answer: ambiguous
the write answer did not come — ambiguous: repeat only with the same id
a connection refused — also «the answer did not come»
a truncated write answer — ambiguous: repeat only with the same id
Fault — its kind: reread and repeat
a cas refusal of a batch names the row: the key does not change the outcome
the guard is not at that version: do not repeat, reread the condition
the outcome of the write is unknown
the body is over the limit — Fault, its kind: reduce the body, do not repeat with the same one
the identity is not admitted or there are no rights — Fault, its kind
the operation is not done: repeat at the next step
